purpose: gnsslad4 (kernel q10jr6 / 0356, ioctl 144): power-on ladder, proven steps 1..3 then NEW step 4 (2 s console pause first): + read 0x18005008, 0x180601d0, 0x180600b0, 0x18060240. Readback after every write, Wi-Fi guard before every access. Every step is rolled back at the end (saved original bits restored, vendor off order). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
